summary.text: Aimee Berger-Girvalo, a Democrat, has represented Connecticut House District 111 since January 6, 2021.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, she lives in Ridgefield and earned a B.A. in developmental disability advocacy from the University of Massachusetts at Amherst.
Her career experience includes working as an operations manager with Hard Rock Café International and as an applied behavior analysis therapist.
